neighborhood_overview: Our location is central, perfect spot to start discovering the city, visiting the main historical monuments on foot, surrounded by numerous restaurants and nightlife area is just around the corner. The Douro River is within 5-10 mins walking distance and the famous Port Wine Cellars are just across the D. Luis I bridge.
host_about:
O edifício do Porto Wine Hostel está definido pela arquitetura clássica portuguesa. A decoração tem como base o famoso vinho do Porto. Os quartos são coloridos, nomeados e decorados de acordo com diferentes tipos de vinho do Porto.
O Porto Wine Hostel está situado no centro histórico, com uma vista deslumbrante para o Jardim da Cordoaria e a Torre dos Clérigos. A nossa localização é central, sendo um local perfeito para começar a descobrir a cidade, visitando os principais monumentos históricos a pé. O rio Douro está dentro de 5-10 minutos a pé e as famosas Caves de Vinho do Porto encontram-se do outro lado da ponte D. Luís I. Está rodeado de numerosos restaurantes, cafés e bares, e a vida noturna está mesmo ao virar da esquina. 
À volta do Hostel existem diversas paragens de autocarro e metro que o levam até diferentes partes da cidade (Casa da Música, Jardim Botânico, Museu de Serralves, o Parque da cidade, às praias e ao Oceano Atlantico, Matosinhos). Os autocarros nº 601 e 602 permitem uma ligação direta desde o aeroporto Francisco Sá Carneiro até ao centro da cidade, com uma duração de cerca de 50min. A estação de comboio e de metro São Bento estão a uma distância de 5min a pé. Aí pode ir de comboio até Braga, Guimarães, Aveiro, Coimbra e muitas outras cidades que valem a pena visitar. O metro também tem uma linha até ao aeroporto Francisco Sá Carneiro.
É a localização perfeita para explorar a cidade e ter umas ótimas férias.

The colorful houses of Miragaia are constructed below the level of river Douro, on an ancient beach that served as a medieval shipyard, where the boats were built during the Discoveries Era. Nowadays, the houses are protected by a large wall and the upper floors are built over arches, which gives the whole neighborhood a very special atmosphere.

The heart of Miragaia is the Church of São Pedro, where, for centuries, were saved the relics of St. Pantaleon of Nicomedia, brought from Armenia to Portugal, after the fall of Constantinople, in 1453, in the hands of the Turks.

neighborhood_overview:
The Ponte das Barcas bridge was the first of many to cross the Douro River in Porto, linking north and south banks. After its collapse, it was replaced in 1843 by the suspended bridge Ponte Dona Maria II, the supporting pillars of which can still be seen to this day alongside the Ponte Dom Luís. The first iron bridge was also inaugurated in 1843. A railway bridge, called Ponte Dona Maria which stands to this day, it was designed by Gustave Eifel and was considered a feat of engineering at the time. The more famous Ponte Dom Luís, an icon today for the city of Porto, was opened to the public in 1886, and was designed by Teophile Seyrig, a former partner of Eifel.

At the end of the 19th century, in 1891 unrest by Republicans led to a revolt in the city, a key event in the history of Porto and Portugal that would eventually culminate in the declaration and creation of the Portuguese Republic in 1910.

name: Apartment in Bonfim with balcony and mezzanine
description:
Welcome to Oporto!
The apartment is located in the beautiful town centre, surrounded by historical monuments and main points of interest.
Bus and train station offering airport connection are all within walking distance.
Inside, the decoration is nature inspired, with a sensation of ease and tranquility, offering a great harmony between a lively city and the surrounding countryside.
Have the pleasure of feeling like a "Portuense"!
neighborhood_overview:
There are no malls in Bonfim, but plenty of cool independent stores, mostly on Rua de Santo Ildefonso. Keep an eye out for bookshop Inc. (no 25), a recent outpost of lifestyle outlet Patch (no 95), and the intimate emporium of cheeses and preserves that is Queijaria Amaral (no 190).

Being home to Porto university’s fine arts faculty means Bonfim has always had an active arts scene. For contemporary art, the Senhora Presidenta (Joaquim António de Aguiar 65) and Lehmann + Silva (Duque da Terceira 179) galleries never disappoint. For fans of documentary photography, the recently launched Salut au Monde! (Santos Pousada, 620) is a must.

For superb views over the Douro, stroll around the Parque de Nova Sintra (R. do Barão de Nova Sintra). Once private, this small leafy park is now owned by the water authority and has a wonderful collection of old fountains. ( The Guardian, 2020 ).

name: The Theatrical Apartment | Cedofeita
description: Located in a renewed 19th century building, situated in one of the main pedestrian streets of the city. The appartment faces the pedestrian street and the interior garden, offering a sight of the two worls of Porto.
neighborhood_overview:
Rua de Cedofeita is a pedestrian street with traditional shops and some cafes and restaurants. It is on the edge of "the arts neighborhood". The area is very lively and the street is a very important connection axis for the Porto's daily life.
There are a lot of bars and restaurants in the vicinity and the nightlife area is within a 5 minutes walking distance.
host_about:
EN
We are a couple of architects who, after a few years living in several countries, realized their dream of renovating a building from the 19th Century in Porto and living in the center of this fascinating city. Here we have placed our affection and some of our stories and experiences that we share with those who visit us, under the fig tree or lying in the grass of the garden - one of the secrets of this Porto corner.

PT
Somos um casal de arquitetos que, depois de alguns anos a viver em vários países, realizou o seu sonho de renovar um edifício do Sec. XIX, no Porto e de viver no centro desta apaixonante cidade. Aqui depositámos o nosso carinho e algumas das nossas histórias e experiências que partilhamos com quem nos visita, debaixo da figueira ou estendidos na relva do jardim - um dos segredos deste recanto do Porto.

neighborhood_overview:
Bonfim is one of the 20 coolest neighborhoods in the world in 2020.
The genuine identity of Porto, which is beginning to disappear in more central areas of the city, is still very much alive in Bonfim. With a strong spirit of community and proximity trade – now more important than ever – there are small cafes and shops, some of the most traditional restaurants in the city, but also more modern signature cuisine spaces. With great creative impulses, largely due to the Faculty of Fine Arts and the galleries, there is an artistic itinerary to discover in Bonfim. And now that it is becoming more and more pedestrian, it is even more inviting to explore the area on foot, through the streets that preserve traditional features of urban architecture and the refuges in the middle of nature, such as the Nova Sintra Park, overlooking the river Douro.

2004, during the Football european championship I rented out a fully furnished and equipped flat in Porto to foreign guests. It was the one in Boavista. 
The experience was great. The people who stayed loved the apartment, and I loved the concept of renting my flat to visitors. I prepared the flat not only with furniture and bed linen! I tried to gather useful information about Porto and surroundings in order to help my guests make the best of their time in town.
Then friends and family, who either got married and saw their families grow or had to move abroad, started asking me to take care of their flats, apartments or townhouses and find guests. Again, I prepared the flats so that anyone visiting Porto would feel welcome and easily integrated in Porto.
Well, now it's two of us, me and my colleague Paula (https://www.airbnb.pt/users/show/180050) and we decided to create a small company called Flat in Porto to manage all these flats and get them ready to welcome you in our city. 
All of these homes still have the owners' own touch, so you get an inside feeling of how people live in Porto. We hope you like your new temporary home in Porto, no matter if you are on holidays, studying or working here, and we do hope you enjoy your stay with us!

The access platform is just 200 meters from the apartment.
